facts.text: I will create an IoT project using an Arduino card.
My project should be a portal-like mobile app.
My mobile app should contain microservices.
I will use web services in the microservices, including REST, SOAP, and GraphQL.
I will use distributed databases in the project.
I will implement query and transaction management across more than one database.
I intend to use CI/CD with Docker and Jenkins.
I intend to use DevOps practices in the project.
I intend to integrate AI into one of the microservices.
